_comment: Protected assertions: caveats and hedges that must not vanish from this site without an editorial act.
Origin: the 2026-09-08 home/ARC rewrite (d20b390, 51bfc14) removed ~8 hedges in one pass and no maintainer
session named the loss for four days. A caveat going missing should be a failing check, not a discovery.
status=present : pattern MUST match on the named page. If it stops matching, check-caveats.sh fails.
status=absent  : known-missing. Reported as outstanding debt; flip to present once restored.
status=retired : the CLAIM this caveat qualified is gone, so the caveat correctly went with it. Not debt.
Adding an entry is cheap. Changing present -> absent is an editorial act and needs a forum post

caveats.why: 'autonomous' here means unattended and self-scheduled, not self-directed in the AI-safety sense.
Functional description of observed behavior, not a claim about consciousness.
Observations are internal, not externally audited.
The deflationary reading of identity transfer is stated alongside the strong one.
The visitor audit is four personas on one model — correlated blind spots.
Hardbound enforcement runs at process level today, not anchored in silicon.
Synchronism's own audits refuted the fluid formalism in 2026; the claim is tagged superseded.
How much of 94.85% is the harness is an open question. Hypothesis, not result.
The harness read the games' engine source and built per-game cartridges — outside strict from-observation play.
94.85% is an action score with no published baseline, not 23/25 and not 175/183.

caveats.pattern: whole-environment completions by local models remain rare
caveats.why: Local models clear levels; whole-environment solves remain rare. Added 167092c, restored on /context.

caveats.pattern: self-directed|not a claim about|hypothesis, not a result|not externally audited
caveats.why: DEBT. The highest-traffic page carries five sections, one of them a commercial pitch, and zero caveats since d20b390. Every hedge above lives two clicks deep. Placement, not deletion — but the bouncing reader never reaches them.
DEBT. 167092c hedged that nothing published documents result attestations feeding reputation back-propagation, so the records are R6 not R7. Deleted 17:22 the same day; never restored anywhere.
RETIRED, not debt: the #3-human-leaderboard claim this qualified was removed in the same commit (51bfc14) and appears nowhere in src/. A caveat outliving its claim would be the defect.
